chapter: Race, rock and the craft of vocalese
title: Defining vocalese and being called its father
summary: Vocalese means bringing Eddie Jefferson and King Pleasure's ideas into orchestral form; he accepts the title only on that basis.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Okay. Excellent. Let’s talk about vocalese.
Please. How would you define it and its origins?

Having been in on its origins, I can say that vocalese is the name Leonard Feather applied to the taking of the contributions of Eddie Jefferson and King Pleasure into the orchestral form. That is what vocalese is. It is on that basis alone that I allow myself to be referred to as the father of vocalese. I will accept being the father of vocalese. But if someone referred to me as the father of setting lyrics to jazz solos, I couldn’t accept that, because I am not that. I am a student of that. I was inspired to stretch it into the orchestral form by Moody’s Mood for Love, which is both Eddie Jefferson and King Pleasure. I acknowledge them as my mentors. But since vocalese is the term given to that stretching of it into the orchestral form, I will accept being the father of that.
No-one’s done more for that concept than you. Absolutely. It’s a remarkable thing.
